text:
mike: Postmortem follow-ups from the TLS surge overnight — cross-region handshake spikes caused a retry storm and partial request degradation. Need concrete owners and short timelines.

kate: Assigning owners: @sam (networking lead) and @alex (infra/LB). @nora owns monitoring/alerts.

sam: Got it. I'll run triage today. First steps: confirm egress path, cert chain validity across regions, and correlate retries.

alex: I'll validate LB TLS config + cert rotation logic in staging; will run a targeted verification job.

nora: We saw increased `handshake_error` with `route_set` variance — suspect routing selection instability. I'll add a route-awareness metric.

mike: Proposed action items (short):
  1) Patch routing selection bug
  2) Add metric + alert for handshake failures by route_set/region
  3) Weekly cert-chain verification job
  4) Update runbook + rollout plan (canary)
  5) Postmortem actions table update
Owners & timelines?

sam: Routing fix PR by EOD Thu (owner: @sam). I will open the PR and include test vectors.

alex: Runbook draft by Mon (owner: @alex). For rollout: canary region -> 1% -> 10% -> global, with automatic rollback on increased handshake_error.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary window available tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Use deploy tag `tls-routing-cfix`.

nora: Added metric `lb.tls.handshake_failure_rate{region,route_set}`. Alert: >0.5% sustained for 5m -> paging oncall.

sam: Quick logs query to find correlated retries: 
```
# example loki query
{job="loadbalancer"} | json | stats count() by region,ssl_error,route_set
```

mike: :thumbsup: I'll add these items to the postmortem action table and loop in security/legal if cert rotation policy needs tightening.

alex: I'll open a tracker ticket PROD-4829 and add PR links + canary runbook steps.

nora: I'll also create a weekly cert-chain verify job across all regions and own it.

oncall-sre: Oncall note: if we see recurrence during business hours, switch routing fallback to `fallback_policy=local` to reduce cross-region retries.

sam: Confirmed timeline recap: PR by Thu EOD, metrics+alert by Fri, canary Sat morning (09:00-11:00 UTC), runbook Mon. Will update this thread with PR/ticket links and status.

kate: Thanks all — please ping me if any blocker for the canary window.

mike: Great. Owners: @sam (routing patch + triage), @alex (runbook + rollout), @nora (monitoring + cert checks). I'll follow up in next ops sync and close actions as they land.

alex: Opening tracker now, will post link in thread in 15m.

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/prod/merge/789 — will request review from @kate and @alex.

mike: Noted. Marking this thread as action-tracker for the postmortem.

kate: Thanks team.
